Before restart the display was ['MyCalc', 'STANDALONE', '2']; visible history labels were ['History · 7', 'Clear', 'Close history', '= 3', '200+10%', '27th Oct, 13:14', '= 220', '0.1+0.2', '= 0.3', '(2+3)×4', '= 20', '2+3×4', '27th Oct, 13:13', '= 14'].

results.title: Chained calculations retain unrounded precision
results.comment: After 1 ÷ 3 =, the UI result was ['MyCalc', 'STANDALONE', '0.3333333333']; multiplying by 3 did not return 1. This is consistent with the screen feeding its rounded display string back into the next expression.

results.title: Scientific-notation result can be used in the next expression
results.comment: Initial 10^15 display was ['MyCalc', 'STANDALONE', '1e+15']; adding +1 left an unchanged exponent result or produced Error. This is consistent with exponent-formatted display text not being accepted as a numeric literal by the expression validator/parser.
